name: Unearthed

startedBy.speaker: Ralis Sedarys
startedBy.prompt: I've got some money. Are you looking for a partner?
reply: What? Are you... are you serious? Well, I think I could make that work..
We can sort out the details of our little arrangement later, but for now, I'll manage the dig if you can manage the coin.
startedBy.conditions: Unearthed stage 15 not done; Unearthed stage == 40; the speaker is Ralis Sedarys

startedBy.speaker: Ralis Sedarys
startedBy.prompt: Why not hire some of the miners out of Raven Rock?
reply: You think I've got that kind of money? No, I only get paid on delivery. Can't afford to go out of pocket for a thousand septims on this.
Takes money to make money, all that rot. There's a lot of it at the other end, but I can't get there without a little kick to start it off.
startedBy.conditions: Unearthed stage 14 done; Unearthed stage < 40; the speaker is Ralis Sedarys

startedBy.speaker: Ralis Sedarys
startedBy.prompt: Here's a little gold for your tale. (<BribeCost> gold)
reply: Don't insult me. You don't have nearly enough for this to be worth my time, or yours.
startedBy.conditions: Unearthed stage 14 not done; Unearthed stage 13 not done; Unearthed stage == 20; the speaker is Ralis Sedarys
startedBy.source: DLC2_TIF__02027596.Fragment_0 on INFO Dragonborn.esm:027596 (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

startedBy.speaker: Ralis Sedarys
startedBy.prompt: Spare me the walk. Just tell me. (Persuade)
reply: You've wasted enough of my time already. Just... just let me be.
startedBy.conditions: Unearthed stage 14 not done; Unearthed stage 12 not done; Unearthed stage == 20; the speaker is Ralis Sedarys

startedBy.speaker: Ralis Sedarys
reply: With me? What's the matter with you?
Sorry, I've just had a lot of hork-faced cowards coming by to mock my efforts.
startedBy.conditions: Unearthed hasn't started; the speaker is Ralis Sedarys

startedBy.speaker: Ralis Sedarys
startedBy.prompt: I heard you were starting an expedition?
reply: Who told you that? Was it Geldis? I told that idiot not to send me any more...
startedBy.conditions: Unearthed stage == 10; the speaker is Ralis Sedarys

startedBy.speaker: Ralis Sedarys
reply: When I first got to Kolbjorn, you couldn't even see it. Buried in the ash, like most other things on this blasted island.
Dug out a pile of the stuff taller than me just to find the barrow. Who knows how much to reach the door.
Excavating isn't exactly my specialty. Even if it was, the ash storms fill it in faster than you can dig.

startedBy.speaker: Geldis Sadri
reply: If you've got gold on your hands, you might talk to Ralis, up at Kolbjorn Barrow. I've heard he wants to excavate the place.
startedBy.conditions: the speaker is Geldis Sadri; Unearthed stage < 100; Kolbjorn Barrow Misc Objectives stage <= 10
you're in Kolbjorn Barrow or you're in Raven Rock

firstObjective.text: Fund the excavation of Kolbjorn Barrow (1000 gold)

objective.text: Wait for a message from Ralis

movedBy.speaker: Ralis Sedarys
reply: Hmm... it's all here. Well, then... looks like I have a good bit of work to start on.
I'll head back to Raven Rock and round up some diggers. Once we've got something worth looking at, I'll send word to you.
Pleasure doing business with you, partner. I'll see you soon.
movedBy.conditions: the player has at least 1000 gold; the speaker is Ralis Sedarys

why: OnConfigInit runs once when the menu registers in a new game; it sets `migrated` and calls LoadSettings, which goes on only while bEnabled:Maintenance is set (it is 1) and then calls Load, which reads iWTGeneralRequirementsMinimalLevel:Requirements (10, settings.ini in Wyrmstooth - Settings Loader) and sets WTStartLevel to it

MigrateToMCMHelper, which would copy the global's record value (20.0) into that setting, runs only from OnGameReload or OnConfigOpen while `migrated` is false, and OnConfigInit has already set it, so a new game never migrates (an older save made before the loader would)
OnGameReload reloads the settings only when bLoadSettingsonReload:Maintenance is set; it is 0, so later loads keep whatever the global holds
